The '''1972–73 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]], one point ahead of their nearest rival [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]]. [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]] and [[Airdrieonians F.C. (1878)|Airdrieonians]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1973–74 Scottish Division Two|1973–74 Second Division]].
